units.name: The Zenith Suite
units.description: A luxurious open-flow studio on the 10th floor with custom glass partitions, panoramic metropolitan views, and a private step-out balcony.

units.name: The Grand Horizon Penthouse
units.description: Spanning the top level of the south tower, this ultra-spacious penthouse features double-height ceilings, automated floor-to-ceiling shades, and private plunge pool access.

units.name: The Oasis Garden Loft
units.description: Charming duplex loft featuring exposed structural brickwork, reclaimed timber accents, and a lush private garden terrace perfect for morning coffee.

units.name: The Solarium Duplex
units.description: Bathed in glorious natural light, this southwest-facing duplex offers a spectacular layout ideal for small families or business travelers seeking upscale comfort.

units.name: The Crimson Executive Lounge
units.description: Sleek, moody minimalist studio designed for corporate leaders. Soundproofed glazing, high-end acoustic systems, and dynamic ambient lighting presets.
